## Summary

I implemented F003, the machine-readable command-guidance surface, by adding a new read-only `dontpanic agent commands` subcommand to `_agent_main` in `cli.py` that prints the existing F002 command-guidance inventory (`command_guidance.inventory_public_payload()`) as a stable, versioned JSON envelope — schema version, source summary (vocabulary + entry count), and one entry per command — reading guidance metadata only and never resolving a command path back to a handler, dispatching, or instantiating an executor. I pointed the generated operating brief at the surface by adding a `MACHINE COMMAND GUIDANCE` section/constant to `agent_brief.py` and bumping `GENERATOR_VERSION` 1.0→1.1 (a layout change that correctly re-stamps the F003 managed AGENTS.md block), and updated the agent-usage and top-level help text to list the new subcommand. I added `test_f003_agent_commands_surface.py` (11 tests) covering the versioned-envelope shape, per-entry round-trip through the F001 model, coverage parity with the F002 inventory, byte-stable schema output, read-only behavior (no config write, no dispatch/executor calls), and the brief pointer. Targeted runs are green: the new file plus the brief, guidance, agent-surface-CLI, repo-onboarding, and architecture-view suites all pass (95 + 41 tests, 0 failures); no full sweep was ru
